Implementation
Second-stage joint-noise test; exact subspace reduction
VERIFIED

Owner instruction 'Run them through'. tools/joint_noise_stage.py can reduce a diagonal-covariance target exactly to its timing, red-noise and signal subspace (J1939+2134: 18,191 TOAs to 1,099 rows plus one white-noise term). Unit test against the unreduced calculation; J1939's released-noise member reproduces the fixed-noise statistic 149.353. Results now record that member's statistic. 365 tests pass.
Editing the tool invalidated earlier preparations; all were already consumed.
